notes.title: New Updates are Available!!!
notes.content:
Hello Dear Friends!
We are glad to announce that our first updates were released on October 4th!
Many of you asked for some adjustments and they are here ready for you:
- New menu music theme
- New levels music theme
- Objects mapping Optimization
- New mouse icon
- Scenarios of traps and obstacles were revised by correcting of response time, speed of cycles and the sequence of operation
- Corrections the code responsible for displaying UI

We are still working to add new levels.
We are planning to release a new update for multiple languages as well.

Please leave us your reviews, it is greatly help us to improve the game!

Enjoy!

Steel Punk Ball Dev's.

notes.title: Major Game Updates - coming soon...
notes.content:
Hello Dear Friends!
After two months from game release, we are ready to announce that a major game updates are coming soon:
- New Menu theme
- New Music theme
- New Levels
- Optimization of objects mapping will slightly increase the game performance
- Scenarios of traps and obstacles will be revised by correcting of response time, speed of cycles and the sequence of operation
- Corrections the code responsible for displaying UI
- And much more…
